Mia (devex): hey — hitting a weird combo in the Go sampleapp during onboarding. debug logs are leaking full request IDs even with REDACT_REQUEST_IDS=true :eye_speechless:
Sam L: hmm, are you sure env var is picked up by the binary?
Mia (devex): yep, env printed at startup shows REDACT_REQUEST_IDS=true. only happens when loglevel is set to debug and we have otel hooks enabled.
Julian R: can you paste the startup lines and the log snippet? sounds like hook ordering issue (otlp/log hooks).
Mia (devex): paste below — startup then two lines from later:
```
STARTUP: sampleapp v0.9.1
ENV: REDACT_REQUEST_IDS=true LOG_LEVEL=debug OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION=on
```
2026-03-20T14:03:21Z Mia (devex) DEBUG http.server request_id=01b23c45d67890abcdef1234567890 path=/v1/generate user=alice
2026-03-20T14:03:21Z Mia (devex) DEBUG otel.span trace_id=6f8a... request_id=01b23c45d67890abcdef1234567890
Sam L: odd — our hook should replace request_id with [REDACTED] before it reaches the structured logger. which SDK version?
Mia (devex): using middleware from redwood/sdk-go v0.7.2 (pulled yesterday).
Priya (eng-runtime): this rings a bell — we had a fix about hook ordering in the Python SDK where otel hook ran after the log hook and missed redaction. maybe Go has parity gap.
Sam L: can you try setting LOG_LEVEL=info as a quick test? if debug path triggers additional logging that bypasses the sanitized path.
Mia (devex): set to info — redacted now. so it is log-level dependent.
Julian R: thanks. that suggests debug-level code path logs the raw header before the otel hook swaps in. we should repro with a minimal handler and instrumented hooks.
Mia (devex): repro snippet I used:
```
http.HandleFunc("/v1/generate", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
  log.Debugf("incoming request_id=%s", r.Header.Get("x-request-id"))
  // otel middleware should inject sanitized id
  // ...
})
```
Sam L: two follow-ups: (1) is the header already redacted when it arrives to our server? (2) what order are middleware/handlers registered in sampleapp?
Mia (devex): header seen by net/http is the real id. middleware registration order is: otel.init -> auth.middleware -> logging.middleware -> handler. so logging.middleware runs after auth but it looks like debug log in handler fires before logging.middleware runs.
Priya (eng-runtime): aha — handler-level debug logs will run before our logging.middleware if the middleware wraps the handler incorrectly. we register logging as a PostMiddleware to avoid double-context, but that makes it too late for handler-level debug statements.
Julian R: proposed fix: ensure logging middleware wraps at the outermost layer (first in chain) so it observes and mutates headers early; or have a small helper that sanitizes headers on r.Context() immediately upon accept.
Mia (devex): +1. also want to call out dev onboarding friction: the sampleapp's README doesn't mention the REDACT flag interaction with OTEL. new users will be confused if debug logs leak PII while trying to troubleshoot.
Sam L: good point — short term: update sampleapp README and add a test that asserts no raw request IDs in debug logs when REDACT_REQUEST_IDS=true and OTEL enabled.
Priya (eng-runtime): I'll open a runtime PR to change middleware order and add a unit test. suggest also adding a small link in the onboarding checklist about "set LOG_LEVEL=info for safe onboarding" as a temporary mitigation.
Mia (devex): thanks — can you also add a note for SDK parity: make sure Go and Python SDKs share the same hook contract so redaction is consistent across languages.
Julian R: will follow up in SDK repo. also logging-hooks should have deterministic behavior at all levels (debug/info/warn).
infra-bot: deploy queued for branch/pr-telemetry-redaction (estimated start in ~3m) :rocket:
Sam L: awesome — can we also dump a small sample of how the redacted debug line should look so QA can assert it?
Mia (devex): ideal debug line: 2026-03-20T14:03:21Z Mia (devex) DEBUG http.server request_id=[REDACTED] path=/v1/generate user=alice
Julian R: noted. I'll include that in the PR description and the CI log scan.
Mia (devex): thanks all. will watch the PR and update onboarding doc after merge. :thumbsup:
